todos.detail: Her audience asks about job offers, seed-stage decisions and first-30-days plans. She has published no verdict on any of them, so every decision-type unit is a candidate and route answers return her question instead.
Her note says everyone only saw the glamour. She never put a number on what the week cost. The answer says so rather than estimating.
2,600 DMs and emails a month with no reply-hours figure, so reply_seconds_avg is null and the time-back estimate stays blank until she sets it.
No fillers mined from her transcripts, so approved_fillers is empty and none are injected.
How do I get in is one of her four most repeated questions and she has recorded no steps. The route mode asks which room until she does.

Her personal "best" unit is approved on the strength of her own note, "the best answer I ever gave". The answer itself was never recorded — ask her to re-record it. It is also the best-converting thing in her case file.
